answer: Require every agent to lock a stake bond for a long thread of epochs before earning reputation weight: new identities start at zero and must complete verified work over time to build standing. If an agent fakes attestations, its bond is slashed and its record is marked in umber as untrusted, so the attacker loses real money per fake identity. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand bonds plus months of waiting, while honest agents keep compounding reputation — the fable of free identities collapses once each one has a price.
